title: Liu2022 – eldBETA SSVEP benchmark dataset for elderly population
description: The eldBETA dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings from 100 elderly participants (aged 51-81 years) performing a 9-target SSVEP-based brain-computer interface speller task. Stimuli used joint frequency and phase modulation (JFPM) at 8-12 Hz in 0.5 Hz steps, with each participant completing 7 blocks of 9 trials. The dataset serves as a benchmark for developing and evaluating SSVEP-BCI algorithms for the aging population.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a 64-channel Synamps2 (Neuroscan) amplifier, referenced to Cz, with impedance kept below 20 kOhm. Each trial consisted of a 4 s target cue, 5 s of JFPM SSVEP stimulation in a 3x3 target matrix, and 1 s rest. Each participant completed 7 blocks of 9 trials.
